pages._text: Ada set the little submarine on the water in the bucket. It rocked gently on top and stayed there. How could a real one ever go down deep and then come back?
She leaned closer. Then she stood tall. There had to be a place to test what a submarine really does.
She pressed it under with one finger. The moment she stopped, it shot right back up again. Nothing stayed where she wanted it.
The bucket could not hold a proper test. Ada lifted the submarine and walked toward the bathroom door, sure the tub would serve as her ocean tank.
Water splashed into the big tub. Ada placed the submarine on the rim and thought about what could make it sink on purpose and rise again.
She filled a small bottle, sealed it tight in a bag, and clipped the bag to the submarine. That extra weight might pull it where she needed.
Down went the submarine with the full bag! When air reached the bag it bobbed straight up again and Ada cheered at the sight.
Ada watched the submarine move exactly as she had planned inside the tub. Her eyes widened at the rise and fall she had made happen.
